tieu_de: QC Manager - Core AI Systems Tester, SQL, Python
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Lead End-to-End (E2E) testing across complex, distributed, multi-service systems
Build test strategy and actively participate in testing critical system flows and define testing strategies for new features or major changes
Investigate and troubleshoot production incidents, especially cross-service/system-level issues
Collaborate closely with Engineering & AI teams to identify root causes and prevent recurrence
Validate the behavior, consistency, and output of AI-driven systems, including detecting anomalies, regressions, and unexpected results
Apply AI tools (Vibe Coding) to accelerate testing, log analysis, and system investigation
Define best practices and elevate the team’s capability in system-level quality assurance
yeu_cau:
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in QA/QC for complex systems, distributed systems, or data-intensive platforms
Strong hands-on experience in End-to-End testing & production incident investigation.
Solid coding skills in Python (or equivalent) for scripting, simulation, and validation.
Strong SQL skills for data validation and system verification.
Deep understanding of API integration, client-server architecture, and system workflows.
Experience in test automation, system reliability, and AI-assisted testing workflows.
Ability to work deeply with logs, operational data, and real system behaviors.
Priorities
Strong system thinking: able to see the full picture, not just individual components.
Comfortable operating in fast-paced and ambiguous environments where requirements and product specifications evolve rapidly.
Data-driven, analytical, and proactive in identifying risks to system stability.
High ownership, resilient under pressure, and capable of handling tight deadlines.
Curious and willing to continuously learn in AI/ML and Cybersecurity domains.
quyen_loi:
Competitive Compensation
Cutting-Edge Technology, AI Security
Global Environment

Work on cutting-edge AI Security & Cybersecurity systems at scale.
Have the opportunity to shape standards and quality assessment methods for AI application platforms.
Work in a high-tech environment, tackling complex technical problems with a significant impact on products.
